title: OpenHydroTelemetryGraph
description: Bare-Metal Sovereign Hydrological & Cyber-Physical Actuator Graph (OPEN-HYDRO-v1.0). Defines zero-trust water flow telemetry, purity metrics, local cistern states, and air-gapped actuator isolation bounds.

system_id.description: Unique cryptographic hardware identifier for local hydrological control unit.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of telemetry capture.

jurisdiction.description: Legal jurisdiction dictating statutory water rights.

statutory_daily_limit_liters.description: Statutory maximum daily extraction or usage allowance.

rainwater_harvesting_exempt.description: Indicates if rainwater catchment is legally exempt from municipal utility metering.

flow_rate_lpm.description: Current flow rate in liters per minute.

daily_accumulated_liters.description: Total water volume extracted or distributed during current 24-hour cycle.

cistern_fill_percentage.description: Current capacity level of local water storage cisterns.

turbidity_ntu.description: Nephelometric Turbidity Units measuring water clarity.

total_dissolved_solids_ppm.description: Total dissolved solids in parts per million.

air_gap_active.description: True if external network control paths are physically or logically severed.

external_scada_override_blocked.description: True if remote utility shut-off signals have been neutralized.

local_silicon_authority.description: True if actuation logic relies strictly on edge compute evaluation.

proof_hash.description: SHA-256 state commitment hash across all telemetry parameters.
